Ikuno Dictus ran her heart out in the 
Yushun Himba (Oaks). Though nearly brought 
to her knees by extraordinary fatigue, she 
managed to hold her ground.

"IRON WILL also measures severe fatigue 
buildup in Ikuno Dictus. It warns that 
fatigue levels will remain critically high 
in her next objective, the Shuka Sho."

Though short in distance, it will be a 
grueling race. Even so, with unwavering 
resolve, Ikuno Dictus declared that she 
would aim for the Shuka Sho as planned.

Later, Ikuno Dictus watched the Tokyo 
Yushun (Japanese Derby). She was 
captivated by Ines Fujin's run, which 
pushed far beyond her limits.

She looked so happy, shining brilliantly. 
Burning that vivid image into her heart, 
Ikuno Dictus headed toward the Shuka Sho—
